_how_this_works: In-season notes the refresh layers on top of ESPN. Keyed by player name; every field is optional.
out_until: YYYY-MM-DD you expect him back (beats ESPN's estimate while he is Out).
games_rate: multiplier on his share of games played (0.9 = misses an extra 10%).
fppg_delta: points per game to add to (or take off) his rest-of-season projection.
note: text shown on his card.
skip: true to stop suggesting him to you (adds, stashes, streams); he still counts as a free agent others can take.
This file is public in the GitHub repo. Commit and push to apply it; the next refresh picks it up.
